prompt:
Create a production game sprite atlas for the LOVE BOX equipment from Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker, adapted as ONE playable CQC fighter: ONE hidden adult MSF human operator carrying the box, olive uniform trousers and black military boots visible underneath. The Love Box itself remains the hero, never a robot. References 1 and 2 are actual original game capture and licensed 2010 replica and determine EXACT object design: wide low rectangular salmon-pink corrugated cardboard Love Pack, fine cream-pink pinstripes, cream horizontal label band near bottom reading LOVE PACK with a small heart, original handling pictograms, taped top seam, recessed side carry handles. Reference 3 is a pre-existing MSF soldier sprite sheet and determines painted illustration detail, olive uniform cloth and black boots ONLY; no exposed copied face, no gun. Match the game equipment silhouette and markings closely; the box covers the entire head/torso and most upper legs, with only brief trouser cuffs and TWO human boots below. The box is not pink armor and has no autonomous mechanism. No wheels, robotic legs, tracks, metal plates or glowing lights.

TRUE transparent RGBA PNG, exactly SIXTEEN separate complete fighter poses in EXACT four columns by four equal-height rows, one full box-plus-human unit per cell. Highest native resolution. Smooth detailed inked 2.5D painted game-sprite style, crisp readable outlines, modest realistic cardboard wear, no pixelated or blocky retro art. ALL sixteen fighters face and move toward SCREEN LEFT; shown from a stable side/three-quarter fighting camera. Keep the same box identity, its same scale relative to boots, and one human throughout. Box occupies about65% of the cell width; whole fighter at most65% of cell height and75% of cell width, substantial empty alpha gutters and outer borders. Every extremity remains inside its own cell. True transparent background, no floor, shadows outside silhouette, labels, grid lines, effects, enemies, disconnected props or additional humans.

Reading order, 0 through15: row1: (0) idle, box level and two crouched boots; (1) low guard box slight forward lean; (2) short walking step front boot advances left; (3) opposite walking step rear boot comes forward. Row2: (4) duck, box lowers near boots; (5) body-bash windup backward tilt with both boots grounded; (6) active forward body-bash left with near boot braced, no projectiles; (7) low left kick, one human black boot protrudes forward from beneath the intact box, other boot supports. Row3: (8) hidden operator reaches one olive-clothed arm with black glove from box lower side to grab left, face remains completely hidden; (9) throw follow-through, same arm draws inward while box tilts, no victim; (10) hide, box flat on floor-line with barely visible two tucked boots; (11) short hopping bump with boots tucked up, no external effect. Row4: (12) recover to crouched normal box; (13) hit reaction box tipped backward right and two human boots scrabble; (14) KO: same box tipped onto its side with two human trouser legs and black boots exposed, no head/face or blood and no separate lost box; (15) get-up: same box regains upright position, human legs fold back under it. Real authored poses for every cell, no duplicate stamps. Lettering readable as printed packaging only. The four-row atlas contains only this salmon-pink boxed human operator.
IMPORTANT: Draw a new native LEFT-facing atlas, do not mirror pixels or typography. The fighter kicks and reaches screen LEFT in active poses, the short visible end panel is now on the RIGHT, boot toes point LEFT, and LOVE PACK heart lettering remains readable and never mirrored. All empty space has actual alpha0; no shadows or low-alpha background colors.
